# Upstream SkiaSharp API inventory

Commit: [`b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8`](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/tree/b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8). Audited 2026-09-11.

Lexical extraction of public type and public member declarations from C# sources. Includes overload declarations and all preprocessor branches; inherited members are not expanded. Not a compiler-generated API contract and not evidence of implementation coverage.

The extraction covers **229 source files**, **323 public type identities**, and **3995 public member declarations**, including overloads and enum values. Partial classes and common platform names are merged by namespace-qualified identity.

## Full signatures

Every extracted signature, source path, and line is available in `upstream-public-api.json`. The input source snapshots are retained in `upstream-sources*.json` and the extraction script is `build_inventory.py`.

## Scope limits

- Conditional compilation branches are inventoried together; they are not all available on every .NET target.
- Explicit interface implementations, inherited members, compiler-generated members, non-public declarations, and extension methods from external packages are not expanded.
- A lexical parser can misclassify unusual declarations. Treat this as a review checklist and compare a compiled reference assembly before promising binary or exact overload parity.
- This inventory describes upstream. It does not assert that a JavaScript port implements these APIs.
